description: CI cargo llvm-cov on branch fz-go4.1/frontdoor-cli-ownership times out in compiler2::semantic_analysis_test::compiler2_runtime_demand_keeps_a_returned_direct_callable_out_of_first_class_inventory with TimedOut { jobs_ran: 165, pending_jobs: 2 }, while local cargo test --lib passes. The test is being ignored to unblock CI. Re-enable it by resolving the Linux/coverage-mode progress budget or underlying runtime-demand convergence issue, then remove the ignore.

comments.text: Expand scope to the runtime-demand callable-surface timeout cluster observed under CI llvm-cov: compiler2_runtime_demand_records_the_exact_surface_for_a_direct_lambda_call, compiler2_runtime_demand_marks_an_escaped_callable_first_class, and compiler2_runtime_demand_keeps_a_returned_direct_callable_out_of_first_class_inventory. Investigation should start from facts, not guesswork: build a fresh fz2 binary, run the smallest reproducing fixture/source through fz2 with --log-telemetry and staged --dump outputs, then look for duplicated or redundant compiler work before changing behavior.

title: Re-enable returned direct callable runtime-demand coverage test
